headline: Dembele's hat-trick seals 4-1 win for France over Norway, topping World Cup Group I
summary: Ousmane Dembele's first-half hat-trick led France to a dominant victory, securing their position at the top of World Cup Group I. The win sets them up for the Round of 32.
details: France striker Ousmane Dembele scored a first-half hat-trick, guiding his already-qualified team to a 4-1 win over second-string Norway. This victory secured France's top spot in World Cup Group I.
The 2018 World Cup winners started strong, with Kylian Mbappe hitting the crossbar early. Captain Mbappe then delivered a superb pass for Dembele to open the scoring in the seventh minute.
Dembele quickly added a second goal with a well-angled shot. Norway, who had rested 10 key starters including Erling Haaland, pulled one back through Thelo Aasgaard a minute later.
Dembele completed his hat-trick with a fine finish in the 32nd minute. Norway's Jorgen Strand Larsen later had a penalty saved after the restart.
France secured their fourth goal in stoppage time via Desire Doue. They await their Round of 32 opponent, likely Sweden, while Norway will face Ivory Coast in Dallas on June 30.
caption:
Ousmane Dembele scored a sensational first-half hat-trick, leading France to a dominant 4-1 victory over Norway!

France striker Ousmane Dembele scored a first-half hat-trick, guiding his already-qualified team to a 4-1 win over second-string Norway. This victory secured France's top spot in World Cup Group I.

The 2018 World Cup winners started strong, with Kylian Mbappe hitting the crossbar early. Captain Mbappe then delivered a superb pass for Dembele to open the scoring in the seventh minute.

Dembele quickly added a second goal with a well-angled shot. Norway, who had rested 10 key starters including Erling Haaland, pulled one back through Thelo Aasgaard a minute later.

Dembele completed his hat-trick with a fine finish in the 32nd minute. Norway's Jorgen Strand Larsen later had a penalty saved after the restart.

France secured their fourth goal in stoppage time via Desire Doue. They await their Round of 32 opponent, likely Sweden, while Norway will face Ivory Coast in Dallas on June 30.

headline_marked: [[Senegal routs 10-man Iraq 5-0]] to keep World Cup hopes alive, end opponents' run
headline: Senegal routs 10-man Iraq 5-0 to keep World Cup hopes alive, end opponents' run
summary: Senegal delivered a dominant performance, securing a crucial victory that keeps their World Cup knockout stage aspirations alive while eliminating Iraq from the competition.
details: Senegal crushed 10-man Iraq 5-0 on Friday, remaining in contention for a spot in the round of 32. This decisive victory simultaneously ended Iraq's hopes of reaching the World Cup knockout stages.

The West African team had an excellent start, with Abdoulaye Seck's header deflecting off teammate Habib Diarra into the Iraqi net in just the fourth minute. Iraq faced further setback when defender Rebin Sulaka was sent off in the 12th minute after a VAR review for pulling down Sadio Mane, who was through on goal.

Senegal capitalized on their numerical advantage, running riot after the break with goals from Ismaila Sarr, Iliman Ndiaye, and a double by Pape Gueye. The team now awaits results to see if they will advance as one of the eight best third-placed teams.
